q12.
frontend hook — `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (`useMemos` / `useInfiniteMemos` call `memoServiceClient.listMemos`)
client file — `web/src/connect.ts` (exports `memoServiceClient` via Connect transport)
proto RPC — `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`rpc ListMemos`)
backend handler file — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`APIV1Service.ListMemos` → `s.Store.ListMemos`)
store method file — `store/memo.go` (`Store.ListMemos` → `s.driver.ListMemos`)
dialect implementation file — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (`DB.ListMemos` builds and runs the SQL query)
